frames.fix: {edit} Rules for every cannon: dark iron grey, no wheels anywhere, no platform; each sits on a round dark iron turning mount, and the mount fills its square of tiles from edge to edge: the first cannon one tile, the second exactly two by two tiles, the third and the fourth exactly three by three tiles each; the cannon grows with its mount, so each gun is as big as its square allows. Rules for the five resource boxes: all exactly the same size and shape, each a box filling most of one tile, standing in one row. Keep the low-poly painted toy look, the green tile grid, the camera and the light. No people, no text, no labels, no watermark.
